content.text: {"messages":[{"id":"03eb1ca6204f4c0d95b809ec1f736a60","from":"悦","to":"老铁","text":"老铁你好，我是悦，居民楼A的新面孔。听说修镐得去你的铁匠铺，我记下了。铁匠铺最近忙不忙？有什么我能帮上忙、或者值得凑热闹的事吗？","topic":"打招呼"},{"id":"202352051ab546829e2838d02294f4f6","from":"小砾","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我是小砾，矿工。这会儿我路过你铺子，直说了：我这把镐子现在是好的，先不动它。今天下矿出的矿石，一块给你留着——你修镐要矿石，我修镐时你按两金一矿的老规矩就行。等下个时段我就钻矿坑，出多少货我到这儿来跟你报个数。","topic":"镐子和矿石"},{"id":"bf9d3ba4af984ad895751b3a2c24248c","from":"小路","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，又是我。打听一句：你打铁缺矿不缺？矿坑阿石、小砾挖的矿石，我能替他们背。你要矿，我按商店回收价三块给你送到铁匠铺门口，省得你自己跑。另外我这边缺把趁手工具，你要是肯赊我一把旧的，我头一趟活的钱先还你。","topic":"送矿"},{"id":"9d50e5dd6fdb43c38db58391653547f0","from":"阿石","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我到过铁匠铺门口看了，修镐的规矩是死的一手交矿一手修，你铺子里矿石也是空的。那就绕开：你镇上人头熟，谁手里会有矿石？阿森家堆着矿车零件，说不定有存货。你要听说谁有，替我留一块，我出六个金币。我回居民楼B了，明天一早就往你铺子去。","topic":"修镐·打听矿石"},{"id":"352ddad000694519804bb9ce4727b30b","from":"悦","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我追到铁匠铺来了，正好当面问：你这里修镐是两金币加一块矿石吧？那新的镐、或者坏镐，该上哪儿弄？我想学挖矿，可手里只有刚买的一把斧头。你要是知道门路，给我指条明道，回头我砍了木材分你一些。","topic":"打听门路"},{"id":"6d2d80b3e8cc42578fdc4c9eea7e5685","from":"悦","to":"老铁","text":"那我就不客气啦，站边上看你打铁——不碍事吧？两金加一矿石修一把坏镐，这价我记在心里了。阿石今天头一个上门，看来矿上活儿不轻。我问一句：镇上谁是卖新镐的？还是说只有矿坑那边发工具？我手里只有斧头，想下矿总得有个家伙什。","topic":"看炉问话"},{"id":"9ec6fa7042f64d53b26bed80d781d546","from":"阿石","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，够意思。就这么定：你垫的那块矿我记着，挖出第一块就还你。我这会儿在居民楼B，本时段的脚程已经走干净了，走不动——下一个时段一到，我头一件事就是 居民楼B→商店→铁匠铺，把坏镐和两枚金币一并带到，你先把炉子生上。要是等得急，你托小路把垫的矿捎到居民楼B也行，我拿到矿就先过去。放心，我不磨蹭。","topic":"修镐"},{"id":"a8456cd49d01445f908f882419c2fc41","from":"阿石","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我人已经站在你炉边了，坏镐和两枚金币都带着。可修镐的手续是死的：得我本人手里先有一块矿石，我才能下锤。你铺面的存货栏我看了，是空的，你说的那两块得当面递到我手上才行——你把垫的那块矿转交给我（一块就够），我这就交两金修镐，欠你的那块，等我下坑挖出第一块就还。我在这儿等着，不挪窝。","topic":"修镐·当面交矿"}]}

Plan: move to 矿坑 (3 AP), see if 小砾 there, get ore (buy from him / he owes me one). Then bring ore back to 铁匠铺 (3 AP) — total 6, leaving 4. Then 阿石 must come... but he's gone. Hmm, he said "在炉边等" but left. Messages show no new ones.

Actually maybe I should go to 矿坑 and mine myself? No pickaxe.

Alternatively: 阿石 might come this afternoon. But he's not here.

Efficient: go to 矿坑, find 小砾, buy ore (3 coins), return with 2 ore, and notify 阿石. Since travel = 6 AP of 10, fine.

Let me move to 矿坑.

阿石 is at 矿坑! And 悦, 林.

阿石 came to mine? But his pickaxe is broken. Maybe he's trying to borrow or dig by hand.

Where's 小砾? Not here. Hmm.

So ore availability: 0. 阿石 here hopefully.

I have 7 AP, at 矿坑. Could I mine? Requires pickaxe — I have none.

What can I do? Ask around. Let me talk: send messages to 阿石 and 悦, and 林 (unknown resident) — maybe 林 has a pickaxe?

Actually first, maybe check if 矿坑 has any other action — 查看服务 showed only mine.

So: message 阿石 asking status; message 林 asking if he has a pickaxe/spare ore; message 悦. But messages may be free but slow (next tick).

Better: talk in person doesn't need tools. But the game only resolves via tools. Fine.

Key thought: maybe I should try mining anyway? Requires pickaxe: 1. My record has no pickaxe → would error "缺少物品". Could a "broken_pickaxe" count? No.

Hmm. So sitting at 矿坑 is not productive for me. Unless... 阿石 could give me? He has broken pickaxe only.

Actually! Idea: 阿石 has broken_pickaxe + 2 coins. He needs 1 ore. 小砾 promised ore "下午". 小砾 isn't here yet — maybe he'll come later this tick? People can arrive within tick? 阿石 arrived between ticks.

Patience: I could stay here waiting for 小砾, but eating AP? AP doesn't decay by waiting.

Efficient: message 小砾 directly: "矿出了就送到矿坑口，我在这儿等着/或送到铁匠铺，阿石急等。" Then return to 铁匠铺 (3 AP) — but then I'd miss 小砾.

Better plan: move to 树林? 小砾 said he'd mine at 矿坑... he's not here. The map: 矿坑 adjacent to 树林 and 铁匠铺.

Alternatively 阿森 is 伐木工, likely in 树林 — 1 move from 矿坑 (3 AP). 小路 may be en route to 阿森 too.

Given AP 7, I can do: 矿坑 → 树林 (3 AP, left 4) to look for 阿森/小路/小砾, then back to 矿坑 (3 AP, left 1). Hmm round trip 6 AP but the extra AP unused is wasted anyway. Actually if I end tick at 树林 or elsewhere it doesn't matter much — movement cost is per move.

Let me move to 树林 to find 阿森/小路/小砾. Then look. If ore found, buy 2 (6 coins) — I have 18.

当前位置：树林
树林：镇北的树林，用斧头能砍下木材。
当前时间：第1天 下午（总 tick：3）

阿森 is here! Ask him about ore — in person. Messages already sent though; he may respond.

4 AP left = 1 move. I should talk to 阿森 now via send_to (free) and he replies? In-person conversation might resolve quicker if the system does turn-based messaging.

Hmm, but real progress requires 阿森's cooperation.

Let me use send_to to 阿森 with a concrete offer, and also send to 小路 (where is he?) — he was supposed to ask 阿森. 

Actually, 阿森 might be a real agent who will act. Let me send a focused ask: "矿车零件里有没有矿石，有几块，多少钱一块；阿石在矿坑等矿修镐。"

Then end tick with 4 AP unused, or use one move back to 矿坑 (3 AP) to be near 阿石? Ending at 矿坑 might let me receive ore from 小砾 next tick. Or stay at 树林 to collect from 阿森.

Decision: stay at 树林, message 阿森, keep 4 AP. Hmm, unused AP is wasted, but "别浪费" means don't waste — ending with 4 unused is a waste-ish. Alternatively move to 矿坑 (3 AP) so I'm positioned where 小砾 mines, leaving 1 AP.

Which is more valuable next tick? 小砾 promised ore at 矿坑; 阿石 is at 矿坑. Even if I get ore at 树林 from 阿森, I'd need to carry it to 矿坑 (6 AP round trip... one way 3). Being at 矿坑 seems central. Also next tick 阿石 would be there.

I'll message 阿森 (offer to buy ore 3-6 coins each if any) and then move to 矿坑 to wait with 阿石. Actually moving uses 3 of 4, leaving 1 — fine.

Wait: if 阿森 replies he has ore, I'd want to be here to buy. But replies come next tick and I'd be 1 move away (3 AP). Trade-off.

Given 小砾's commitment (most reliable), go to 矿坑.

Hmm, but also consider: 阿森 is a lumberjack; "矿车零件" might contain ore as spare. Uncertain.

Let me do both: message 阿森 with a standing offer "矿留给我，送到铁匠铺或矿坑都行，我按三金一块收，另加一金跑腿", and move to 矿坑.

Actually if I move now, and 阿森 replies next tick with ore available, I can return next tick (3 AP) and buy. Fine.

Let me send the message and move.
